item.title: Good Morning Family - 25 May 2026
item.description:
Good morning Walkers!
Hello everyone!
Today is Monday, the 25 May.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be rainy, with a low of 10 degrees and a top of 17 degrees.
There is about a 43 percent chance of rain.
It sounds like a good day for comfy clothes.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is O.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter O?
. . . . . . . . . . . . .
